body.text: Three children and a teacher were killed at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, before a community member who followed the 16-year-old attacker inside shot and stopped him.

Police say the attacker was dead within minutes of the first 911 call; the intervener is unidentified and no charging decision has been reported. Recommendation: pause promotional posts this weekend and do not use the event in marketing.
